assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: geometry/land_use.geojson partitions the provisional site boundary into a 300m-wide heritage-park spine, the three official key-area rectangles (net of the spine), and two side wings split by the spine centerline. This is the agent's conceptual zoning method for the 'one line, three stations, two wings' idea, not a statutory zoning map.
assumptions.impact: Zone boundaries, land_use_code assignments, and derived areas must be re-drawn by a licensed planning team once cadastral parcels and official land-use control data are available.

assumptions.statement: road_area_sqm and road_ratio in metrics.json are derived from road centerline length multiplied by schematic cross-section widths (greenway 10m, branch 14m, secondary 20m, transit_connection 18m), not from an approved road red-line or ROW.
assumptions.impact: Once official road red-lines and cross-section standards are published, road_area_sqm, road_ratio, and the mobility figure must be recalculated.

assumptions.statement: geometry/buildings.geojson contains six illustrative massing blocks (one to two per station) used to demonstrate retain/renovate/new-build logic and to compute a schematic building_density_ratio; it is not a parcel-level architectural footprint survey.
assumptions.impact: total_floor_area_sqm and floor_area_ratio remain status=unknown until official height/intensity controls and a parcel-level building survey are available; do not treat building_density_ratio as a statutory density control.
